# Land Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LandTenure`](gmeow-LandTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LandTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified, time-scoped fact that a party holds rights over a place — ownership, lease, easement, mortgage, usufruct, or another property right. Bridges the locations module to the rights module by referencing [`RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md). Distinct from [`JurisdictionTenure`](gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md) (governance/sovereignty) and [`RegulatoryOverlay`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) (regulation): [`LandTenure`](gmeow-LandTenure.md) is about property rights. Contested titles coexist as multiple standpoint-indexed instances, never collapsing to a single winner ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify a time-scoped property right (ownership, lease, easement, mortgage, usufruct) a party holds over a place, bridging to the rights slice.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for governance ([`gmeow:JurisdictionTenure`](gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md)) or regulation ([`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md)), and avoid deleting an expired tenure — keep it with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Mint [`LandTenure`](gmeow-LandTenure.md), set [`gmeow:tenurePlace`](../properties/gmeow-tenurePlace.md) / [`gmeow:tenureParty`](../properties/gmeow-tenureParty.md) / [`gmeow:tenureType`](../properties/gmeow-tenureType.md), reference rights via [`gmeow:tenureRights`](../properties/gmeow-tenureRights.md), and model joint ownership or contested titles as multiple standpoint-indexed instances ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### Examples

- ex:lt a [`gmeow:LandTenure`](gmeow-LandTenure.md); [`gmeow:tenurePlace`](../properties/gmeow-tenurePlace.md) ex:parcel42; [`gmeow:tenureParty`](../properties/gmeow-tenureParty.md) ex:owner; [`gmeow:tenureType`](../properties/gmeow-tenureType.md) [`gmeow:tenureTypeOwnership`](../individuals/gmeow-tenureTypeOwnership.md).
